invariants.rationale: If result is non-null, its id is set to that of tile before returning.
When result is non-null, it was constructed with non-null arrays for frames and intervals.
tileElement is used unconditionally in the method and is required for getChildByName.
If there is no animation child, the result is null, and vice versa.
When result is non-null, it is constructed from at least one frame tile.
